title: Northgate Delivery & Installation Booking Conditions: Merchandise, Service Area and Delivery Dates
content:
A Northgate Delivery & Installation service level is booked only when the merchandise, the address and the delivery date all fall within that level's limits. Each limit is read from the service level's own figures and from the appointment's records.

## Conditions of booking

1. **Merchandise.** A service level is booked only for merchandise in its eligible merchandise classes and no heavier than its heaviest single item accepted.
2. **Service area.** An address farther than the service level's farthest delivery distance from the delivering club is not served. The distance is the road miles from the delivering club recorded on the appointment, computed at booking.
3. **Delivery date and window.** The delivery date booked must fall no earlier than the level's earliest delivery date and no later than its latest delivery date, each counted in calendar days after the booking date, in one of the arrival windows the level offers. The booking date and the delivery date are those on the appointment record.

| Condition | Checked against | Met when |
|---|---|---|
| Merchandise class | The level's eligible classes | The merchandise is in one of them |
| Weight | The level's heaviest single item | The item is not heavier |
| Distance | The level's farthest delivery address | The recorded road miles are not farther |
| Earliest date | Calendar days after the booking date | The delivery date is not earlier |
| Latest date | Calendar days after the booking date | The delivery date is not later |
| Window | The level's arrival windows | The window booked is one of them |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical figures)

Take a level whose earliest delivery date is 3 calendar days after booking and whose latest is 30, booked on day 0:

- a delivery date on day 3 is no earlier than the earliest date and may be booked; day 2 is earlier and may not;
- a delivery date on day 30 is no later than the latest date and may be booked; day 31 is later and may not.

Take a level whose farthest delivery address is 100 road miles: an address recorded at 100 road miles is not farther than 100 and is not excluded by the service-area condition; an address at 101 road miles is farther and is not served.

Take a 300 lb heaviest item: a 300 lb item is not heavier and meets the weight condition; a 301 lb item does not.
